# vantage_dashboard_notification (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vantage_dashboard_notification" "demo_notification" {
  title           = "Weekly Executive Dashboard"
  dashboard_token = vantage_dashboard.demo_dashboard.token
  frequency       = "weekly"
  user_tokens     = ["usr_36b848747e1683bc"]
  workspace_token = "wrkspc_47c3254c790e9351"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dashboard_token` (String) The Dashboard token.
- `frequency` (String) The frequency the DashboardNotification is sent. Possible values: daily, weekly, monthly.
- `title` (String) The title of the DashboardNotification.

### Optional

- `recipient_emails` (List of String) Email addresses that receive the notification. Must be organization users, on the account's SSO domain, or an approved third-party service address.
- `user_tokens` (List of String) The Users that receive the notification.
- `workspace_token` (String) The token of the Workspace to add the DashboardNotification to. Required if the API token is associated with multiple Workspaces.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the dashboard notification
- `token` (String) The token of the DashboardNotification
